title: Avoid reading the preparation lock file when inspecting a retained candidate
outcome: Avoid reading the preparation lock file when inspecting a retained candidate
acceptance: On Windows, read_prepared can inspect a complete explicitly selected candidate while prepare holds its existing lock, by validating the ordinary bounded lock file through its opened no-follow handle metadata without reading its bytes; owned fixtures prove success and refusal preserve all input bytes and entries.

completion.summary: Delivered metadata-only admission of the opaque preparation lock through the opened no-follow handle, preserving ordinary-file/64-byte/reparse checks. Windows regression requires successful candidate inspection while the production lock is held; directory/oversize refusals and all owned inputs are preserved. Full gate and independent Codex/Claude reviews pass on the frozen tree; independent observed acceptance passes 1/1, with acceptance revision 1 unchanged.
